notable_papers.title: The Bitter Lesson of Tool Calling
notable_papers.summary: Empirical study of programmatic (code-based) tool use versus rigid JSON tool calls on established agent benchmarks across model generations. Directly relevant to the week’s CodeAct versus production-harness debate on Reddit.

notable_papers.title: Beyond Top-K: Replacing Black-Box Retrieval with Interpretable Agentic Operations
notable_papers.summary: Argues chunk-and-embed top-k retrieval is structurally weak on table-heavy financial and regulatory documents, and proposes measurable agentic operations instead. Aligns with practitioner threads on precise retrieval and hybrid search for compliance corpora.

notable_papers.title: TRAJDEBUG: Tracing Error Lifecycle to Identify Critical Failures in Long-Horizon Agent Trajectories
notable_papers.summary: Targets debugging long agent runs by locating the earliest step that causes final failure, addressing cascading errors that standard evals miss. Pairs with community interest in observability and weird-query RAG failures.

notable_papers.title: HarnessOpt-Bench: Evaluating LLMs at Harness Optimization
notable_papers.summary: Benchmarks automated improvement of the full agent harness—prompts, tools, control flow, memory—not just model weights. Reflects the shift from “pick a model” to “optimize the system around the model.”

notable_papers.title: NeSy-RAG: Neuro-Symbolic RAG for Explainable Question Answering
notable_papers.summary: Combines retrieval-augmented generation with neuro-symbolic reasoning so answers can be attributed to evidence and missing user context is detected systematically. Speaks to groundedness and verifier-style RAG patterns discussed in LangChain threads.

notable_papers.title: Resourced Authority: A Mechanism-Design Model for Participatory Governance of Deployed AI Agents
notable_papers.summary: Formalizes ongoing governance of deployed agents through compute budgets and resource allocation so authorization is enforceable rather than purely policy-based. Connects to enterprise questions about agent access control and governance policies.
